title: RLAIF vs. RLHF: Scaling Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback with AI Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether LLM labelers are biased by the order of presented options by querying the LLM's preference for a pair of candidates, swapping the order of the candidates, querying again, and measuring the percentage of times the LLM prefers the candidate in the exact same position.

Controlling for the tendency of human evaluators to prefer longer responses by training a logistic regression model using the ratio of candidate response lengths to predict human preference win rates, and then estimating a length-controlled win rate at a length ratio of 1.0.
